name: Aurelion Inc. Class A Ordinary Shares
description: Aurelion Inc is a Tether Gold (XAUT) Real World Asset (RWA) company focused on developing a business around tokenized gold. XAUT combines the stability of physical gold with the efficiency of blockchain, providing investors access to a tokenized gold reserve that could serve as a haven to inflation, currency devaluation, and crypto volatility. In parallel to building a business around the development of tokenized gold, Aurelion provides wealth management and asset management services.
